headline: Capcom confirms breach of CAPCOM ID affecting 11.7 million accounts
summary: Capcom confirmed hackers breached its CAPCOM ID membership service, exposing more than 11.7 million customer email addresses and associated information. The service remains available, though users may now see more phishing attempts.

claims.statement: Capcom confirmed a data breach of its CAPCOM ID membership service affecting about 11.7 million accounts.
